mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 5% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 1% over the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP and retail sales by more than 1% each over the last quarter signals a strengthening demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both real GDP and retail sales increased by more than 1% over the last quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 over the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease & PAYEMS increase > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased and nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 100,000 over the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 1% for three consecutive months signals a supportive monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where the federal funds rate remained below 1% for three consecutive months.
